spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  scan - LAG(scan) OVER (PARTITION BY relid ORDER BY collected_at) AS scans_per_interval
FROM pganalyze.index_stats
WHERE indexrelid = $index
AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  CASE 
    WHEN (blks_hit + blks_read) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * blks_hit / (blks_hit + blks_read), 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS "% From Buffer Cache",
  CASE 
    WHEN (blks_hit + blks_read) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * blks_read / (blks_hit + blks_read), 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS "% From Disk"
FROM pganalyze.index_stats
WHERE indexrelid = $index
AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

WITH per_table_options AS (
  SELECT
    opt.option_name,
    opt.option_value
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions) AS opt
  WHERE c.oid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
),
settings AS (
  SELECT
    name,
    setting
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold',
    'autovacuum_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor',
    'autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age',
    'autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor'
  )
)
SELECT
  s.name,
  COALESCE(p.option_value, s.setting) AS effective_value
FROM settings s
LEFT JOIN per_table_options p ON p.option_name = s.name
ORDER BY s.name

WITH settings AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid,
    c.relname,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN optname = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold' THEN optvalue::int END),
      (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_threshold')
    ) AS vacuum_threshold,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN optname = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor' THEN optvalue::float END),
      (SELECT setting::float FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor')
    ) AS vacuum_scale_factor
  FROM pg_class c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions) AS opt(optname, optvalue) ON true
  WHERE c.oid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
  GROUP BY c.oid, c.relname
)
SELECT 
  ts.collected_at AS time,
  ts.num_dead_rows AS dead_rows,
  (s.vacuum_threshold + s.vacuum_scale_factor * c.reltuples)::int AS threshold
FROM pganalyze.table_stats ts
JOIN settings s ON ts.relid = s.oid
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = ts.relid
WHERE ts.relid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
  AND $__timeFilter(ts.collected_at)

WITH threshold AS (
  SELECT
    c.oid AS relid,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT option_value::int
       FROM pg_options_to_table(c.reloptions) opt
       WHERE opt.option_name = 'autovacuum_freeze_max_age'),
      (SELECT setting::int
       FROM pg_settings
       WHERE name = 'autovacuum_freeze_max_age')
    ) AS freeze_max_age
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE '\_timescaledb%'
    AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')
)
SELECT
  ts.collected_at AS time,
  ts.frozen_xid_age,
  t.freeze_max_age AS threshold
FROM pganalyze.table_stats ts
JOIN threshold t ON t.relid = ts.relid
WHERE ts.relid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
  AND $__timeFilter(ts.collected_at)

SELECT
  finished_at AS "Finished at",
  finished_at - started_at AS "Duration",
  tuples_removed AS "Tuples removed",
  tuples_removed / NULLIF(tuples_removed + tuples_remain, 0) * 100.0 AS "Effectiveness",
  wraparound AS "Anti-wraparound?",
  CASE
    WHEN relid = hypertable_relid THEN '-'
    ELSE regexp_replace(
      relid::regclass::text,
      '_timescaledb_internal.',
      ''
    )
  END AS "Chunk",
  regexp_replace(
    details,
    '^automatic vacuum of table "[^"]+": ',
    ''
  ) AS "Details"
FROM
  pganalyze.vacuum_stats
WHERE
  hypertable_relid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY
  finished_at DESC

SELECT
  ht.owner AS "Owner",
  ht.num_chunks AS "Chunks",
  d.time_interval AS "Chunk interval",
  ht.primary_dimension AS "Dimension by",
  hs.segmentby AS "Segment by",
  hs.orderby AS "Order by",
  ht.compression_enabled AS "Compression"
FROM
  timescaledb_information.dimensions d
  JOIN timescaledb_information.hypertables ht ON ht.hypertable_schema = d.hypertable_schema
  AND ht.hypertable_name = d.hypertable_name
  JOIN timescaledb_information.hypertable_columnstore_settings hs ON hs.hypertable = format('%I.%I', d.hypertable_schema, d.hypertable_name) :: regclass
WHERE
  ht.hypertable_schema = '$schema'
  AND ht.hypertable_name = '$table'

WITH all_tables AS (
    SELECT 'Hypertables' AS type, h.hypertable_schema || '.' || h.hypertable_name AS name
    FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables h

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'PostgreSQL tables' AS type, t.table_schema || '.' || t.table_name AS name
    FROM information_schema.tables t
    WHERE t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
      AND t.table_schema NOT IN (
          'pg_catalog', 'information_schema',
          '_timescaledb_catalog', '_timescaledb_internal'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables h
          WHERE h.hypertable_schema = t.table_schema
            AND h.hypertable_name = t.table_name
      )
),

continuous_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 'Continuous aggregates' AS type, c.view_schema || '.' || c.view_name AS name
    FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates c
),

materialized_views AS (
    SELECT 'Materialized views' AS type, m.schemaname || '.' || m.matviewname AS name
    FROM pg_matviews m
)

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM all_tables
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM continuous_aggregates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM materialized_views
) t
GROUP BY type
ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT
  AVG(s.total_bytes) AS "Avg chunk size",
  cs.before_compression_total_bytes AS "Before compression",
  cs.after_compression_total_bytes AS "After compression",
  ROUND(
    cs.before_compression_total_bytes :: numeric / NULLIF(cs.after_compression_total_bytes, 0),
    1
  ) AS "Ratio"
FROM
  timescaledb_information.hypertables t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL hypertable_compression_stats(
    format('%I.%I', t.hypertable_schema, t.hypertable_name)
  ) cs
  JOIN LATERAL chunks_detailed_size(
    format('%I.%I', t.hypertable_schema, t.hypertable_name)
  ) s ON TRUE
WHERE
  t.hypertable_schema = '$schema'
  AND t.hypertable_name = '$table'
GROUP BY
  cs.before_compression_total_bytes,
  cs.after_compression_total_bytes;

SELECT
    c.chunk_name AS "Name",
    (cds).total_bytes AS "Total size",
    (cds).index_bytes AS "Index size",
    c.is_compressed AS "Compressed",
    c.range_start::text AS "Start time",
    c.range_end::text   AS "End time"
FROM timescaledb_information.chunks c
JOIN LATERAL chunks_detailed_size('$schema' || '.' || '$table') AS cds ON cds.chunk_name = c.chunk_name
WHERE c.hypertable_schema = '$schema'
    AND c.hypertable_name = '$table'
ORDER BY range_end DESC;

spec.title: Chunk interval tuning
spec.description: Current uncompressed chunks from all hypertables must fit into 25% of RAM.

spec.rawSql:
WITH chunk_stats AS (
  SELECT
    max(s.total_bytes) AS max_chunk_size
  FROM
    chunks_detailed_size('events.data') s
    JOIN timescaledb_information.chunks c USING (chunk_schema, chunk_name)
  WHERE
    c.is_compressed = false
),
config AS (
  SELECT
    time_interval AS current_chunk_interval
  FROM
    timescaledb_information.dimensions
  WHERE
    hypertable_schema = 'events'
    AND hypertable_name = 'data'
),
memory AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(mem_total) * 1024 AS memory_bytes
  FROM pganalyze.sys_stats
)
SELECT
  c.current_chunk_interval AS "Current interval",
  format('%s (%s%% of RAM)', pg_size_pretty(s.max_chunk_size), round(100.0 * s.max_chunk_size / m.memory_bytes, 2)) AS "Current uncompressed chunk",
  pg_size_pretty(m.memory_bytes) AS "Total RAM",
  pg_size_pretty(m.memory_bytes * 0.25) AS "Max chunk size",

  round(
  extract(
    epoch FROM (
      m.memory_bytes * 0.25
      / NULLIF(s.max_chunk_size, 0)
      * c.current_chunk_interval
    )
  ) / 86400
) * interval '1 day' AS "Max chunk interval"
FROM
  chunk_stats s
  CROSS JOIN config c
  CROSS JOIN memory m;

spec.title: Columns
spec.description: Num. distinct (*) means a fraction-based extimate

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    a.attname AS "Name",
    pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS "Type",
    COALESCE(ROUND((s.null_frac * 100)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Null %",
    COALESCE(s.avg_width, 0) AS "Avg. size (bytes)",
    CASE
        WHEN s.n_distinct IS NULL THEN 'n/a'
        WHEN s.n_distinct < 0 THEN
            (ROUND(((-s.n_distinct) * c.reltuples)::numeric)::TEXT || '*')
        ELSE
            s.n_distinct::TEXT
    END AS "Num. distinct",
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_index i
            WHERE
                i.indrelid = a.attrelid
                AND a.attnum = ANY(i.indkey)
        ) THEN 'yes'
        ELSE 'no'
    END AS "Indexed?"
FROM
    pg_attribute a
    JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid
    LEFT JOIN pg_stats s ON
        s.schemaname = n.nspname
        AND s.tablename = c.relname
        AND s.attname = a.attname
WHERE
    n.nspname = '$schema'
    AND c.relname = '$table'
    AND a.attnum > 0
    AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY
    a.attnum;

SELECT
    ts.table_bytes + ts.toast_bytes AS "Data + TOAST size",
    ts.index_bytes AS "Size of indexes",
    ts.table_bytes + ts.index_bytes + ts.toast_bytes AS "Total size",
    approximate_row_count(format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass) AS "Approx row count"
FROM pganalyze.table_stats ts
WHERE ts.relid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
ORDER BY ts.collected_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  table_bytes AS "Data size",
  index_bytes AS "Index size",
  toast_bytes AS "TOAST size"
FROM pganalyze.table_stats
WHERE relid = format('%I.%I', '$schema', '$table')::regclass::oid
  AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)

WITH index_list AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT ON (i.indexrelid) i.indexrelid AS index_id,
    i.relid AS table_id,
    c.relname AS index_name,
    i.size_bytes AS size_bytes
  FROM
    pganalyze.index_stats i
    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
  WHERE
    i.relid = format(
      '%I.%I',
      '$schema',
      '$table'
    ) :: regclass :: oid
  ORDER BY
    i.indexrelid,
    i.collected_at DESC
),
index_info AS (
  SELECT
    il.*,
    ix.indkey,
    ix.indnkeyatts,
    ix.indpred,
    ix.indisprimary,
    ix.indisunique,
    am.amname,
    tbl.relname AS table_relname,
    ns.nspname AS table_schema,
    -- Last time PostgreSQL used the index
    pg_stat.last_idx_scan,
    -- Index fillfactor (90 is the PostgreSQL default for B-tree)
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          option_value :: numeric
        FROM
          pg_options_to_table(idx.reloptions)
        WHERE
          option_name = 'fillfactor'
      ),
      CASE
        WHEN am.amname = 'btree' THEN 90
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS fillfactor
  FROM
    index_list il
    JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = il.index_id
    JOIN pg_class tbl ON tbl.oid = il.table_id
    JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid = il.index_id
    JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = tbl.relnamespace
    JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = (
      SELECT
        relam
      FROM
        pg_class
      WHERE
        oid = il.index_id
    )
    LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_indexes pg_stat ON pg_stat.indexrelid = il.index_id
),
widths AS (
  SELECT
    ii.index_id,
    /*
     * Width of index KEY columns.
     *
     * indnkeyatts deliberately excludes INCLUDE columns.
     */
    CASE
      WHEN BOOL_OR(k.attnum <= 0) THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(s.avg_width) :: numeric
    END AS indexed_columns_avg_width,
    /*
     * Width of all columns in the physical table.
     */
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(s2.avg_width) :: numeric
      FROM
        pg_stats s2
      WHERE
        s2.schemaname = ii.table_schema
        AND s2.tablename = ii.table_relname
    ) AS table_columns_avg_width
  FROM
    index_info ii
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ii.indkey [1:ii.indnkeyatts]) AS k(attnum)
    LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = ii.table_id
    AND a.attnum = k.attnum
    LEFT JOIN pg_stats s ON s.schemaname = ii.table_schema
    AND s.tablename = ii.table_relname
    AND s.attname = a.attname
  GROUP BY
    ii.index_id,
    ii.table_schema,
    ii.table_relname
)
SELECT
  ii.index_id AS "ID",
  ii.index_name AS "Name",
  ii.amname || ' (' || string_agg(
    pg_get_indexdef(ii.index_id, k + 1, true),
    ', '
  ) || ')' AS "Definition",
  CASE
    WHEN ii.indisprimary THEN 'PRIMARY KEY'
    WHEN ii.indisunique THEN 'UNIQUE'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Constraint",
  ii.size_bytes AS "Size",
  ii.fillfactor AS "Fillfactor",
  ii.last_idx_scan AS "Last used",
  CASE
    WHEN w.indexed_columns_avg_width IS NULL
    OR w.table_columns_avg_width IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(
      (
        8.0 + w.indexed_columns_avg_width
      ) / NULLIF(
        27.0 + w.table_columns_avg_width,
        0
      ) * CASE
        WHEN ii.indpred IS NOT NULL THEN 0.10
        ELSE 1.0
      END,
      3
    )
  END AS "Write overhead"
FROM
  index_info ii
  JOIN widths w ON w.index_id = ii.index_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_subscripts(ii.indkey, 1) AS k
GROUP BY
  ii.index_id,
  ii.index_name,
  ii.size_bytes,
  ii.amname,
  ii.indisprimary,
  ii.indisunique,
  ii.indpred,
  ii.fillfactor,
  ii.last_idx_scan,
  w.indexed_columns_avg_width,
  w.table_columns_avg_width
ORDER BY
  ii.index_id;

SELECT
  collected_at AS time,
  size_bytes
FROM pganalyze.index_stats
WHERE indexrelid = $index
AND $__timeFilter(collected_at)
